title: Rosalind and the Inventory
author: Edmund Ravensworth
blurb: Paloma Blackwood, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
